_doc: ONE place for server-side latency budgets (p95, ms, measured by the seed RequestTimingMiddleware, read by noctus.dev.latency_report). Class is chosen by: first matching `shell` route glob, else method (GET/HEAD = read, others = write). `overrides` are per-route exceptions and MUST carry a reason.
